description: Department of Labour - Notifying that the Wages Board for the Rubber Cultivation and Raw Rubber Processing Trade proposed to vary the decisions of the Board and calling for objections until 12.00 noon on 31.03.2016
categorisation: This gazette notification concerns the proposed variation of wage decisions under the Wages Boards Ordinance for the Rubber Cultivation and Raw Rubber Processing Trade. It involves regulatory matters (specifying overtime rates) and falls under legal/regulatory framework adjustments rather than government structure/personnel, land, commercial, elections, public service, judicial, or other specialized categories.
